title: Very knowledgeable guide exploring incredibly beautiful buildings
text: Sam was a great guide, very easy to listen to for 3 and a half hours. Learned a lot about Spanish history and culture. Incredibly beautiful places to explore.
author: Claire_W

title: Amazing tour! Learned a lot!
text: It was very informative and we loved walking through the Cathedral and the Alcázar! We also had the opportunity to climb to the top of the Geralda! Amazing views! Highly recommend this tour.
author: Keely_M

title: Great time spent!
text: Delighted we chose to visit Alcazar and Cathedral with a guide as our tour guide Sam was so full of interesting facts we just wouldn't have had the same experience. You're lucky if you get Sam, as he'll have you giggling throughout. Very friendly, very informative and a great way to spend a few hours surrounded by history. Very enjoyable
author: jameswalsh23

title: Sophia was an amazing...
text: Sophia was an amazing tour guide just like her counterpart, Olga. They provided so much information on the history of the Alcázar and the cathedral.. a great walking tour, very communicative, very accommodating and very kind!!
author: Miriam_D

title: Great experience
text: Great tour guide and easy access to the monuments. The guide was very informative and made the tour very enjoyable
author: Marjorie_R

title: A must to understanding Seville
text: Laura was such an exceptional guide. She has such deep  knowledge of Seville and gave great details to what we were seeing. Tours like this gives a broader richer understanding to what you are seeing.  Furthermore Laura is funny and kind!!!
author: Remington_D

title: Nice tour.
text:
Punctual and organized. 
The guide is super friendly and very patient, with great clarity in his explanation. 
Daniel is his name.
author: ninoshtkav

title: Fun Sevilla historical facts with Sam!
text: Sam was so passionate & knowledgeable about historical info about the Cathedral/ Royal palace. Very fun, engaging with a group of 24 people connecting with each of us. Sam’s vibrant personality enlightened us all!
author: CynthiaAnn_J

title: This was a very enjoyable...
text: This was a very enjoyable afternoon. Sam, our guide is a great storyteller when explaining the background of the alcazar and the cathedral. His wit made it even more enjoyable. Having comprehensive background brought the sites to life. I would thoroughly recommend it.
author: Kym_V

title: A great experience!
text: The Seville Cathedral with the tower climb was a great experience! We were unable to join for the Alcazar portion, but they refunded us the cost of the tickets. Good value and beautiful history.
author: John_T
